data.name: Eilqar
data.gender_notes: Eilqar is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who assists and supports Allah in His cause. This name is derived from the Arabic root 'A-L-Q', which means to help, aid or assist. The name Eilqar carries the meaning “The helper of Allah” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Eilqar usually hope their child will grow to embody the helper of allah and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Being a helper and supporter of Allah's cause.
data.etymology: Eilqar belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The helper of Allah.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Eilqar total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

This can manifest in various ways, such as engaging in acts of charity, volunteering for social causes, or even defending the faith against adversaries. The name is often given to children as a reminder of their duty to serve and contribute to their community, and it can be a source of inspiration and pride for those who bear it.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Eilqar" reminds us of our connection to Allah and our role as His servants in the world. It encourages us to focus on our spiritual growth and development, and to strive to improve ourselves and those around us. The name also symbolizes the importance of teamwork and cooperation in the pursuit of noble goals, and it highlights the idea that when we work together for Allah's cause, we can achieve great things. Ultimately, the name "Eilqar" inspires us to be committed and selfless individuals who are willing to go above and beyond to serve Allah and His creation.
